brain.input: k*loom_L on every left LC4+LPLC2 cell, k*loom_R on the right (no heterogeneity, ASSUMPTION)
brain.readout: DNp01 L/R spikes in the last 50 ms (escape profile)
brain.warmup: 5000 steps with no input after the reset; game clock 0 = end of warm-up; warm-up spikes not used

detector.signal: loom(side) = max(0, D_t - D_{t-1}), D = mean darkness (1 - px/255) of the half
detector.halves: left = columns < W/2, right = columns >= W/2
detector.status: ASSUMPTION — dark-looming, growth-only; not derived from the connectome

rules.control: same seed, warm-up, then control_ms with no input

decoder.rule: count GF spikes per side in [now - window_ms, now); both >= n -> JUMP; left only -> RIGHT; right only -> LEFT; neither -> NOOP
decoder.now_ms: end of the current tick (game clock)

decoder.rule: both GF -> JUMP; left GF only -> RIGHT; right GF only -> LEFT; none -> NOOP
